text: Hi, this is my IB Computer Science internal assessment: Driving Theory Practice, a revision tool for the Lithuanian driving theory test. For each success criterion, its name is shown first, and then it is shown working.
Success criterion one is loading questions from a CSV file. When the app opens, it loads the built-in bank and reports two hundred and twenty-one valid questions. That is test F1.
Now I load my own file. It has seven valid rows and three invalid ones. The app loads seven questions and tells me that three rows were skipped. That is test F2.
If I choose an empty file, I get an error message, the Start button stays disabled, and nothing crashes. Then I can load a correct file straight away. That is test F16.
I turn on the timer and start a session. It has thirty questions in random order, and the timer starts from zero.
Each question shows its difficulty. Easy questions give one point, medium two, and hard three.
When I answer correctly, the answer turns green, I see the explanation, and my score goes up.
When I answer wrongly, my answer turns red, the correct one turns green, and I can't change my answer.
I can also use only the keyboard: A to D to answer, and Enter to go on. The key hint is always on the screen.
Now I answer the rest quickly. I get the easy ones wrong on purpose, so that I have mistakes to practise later.
The results screen shows my score and percentage, how many answers were correct and wrong, the result for each difficulty, and the time. These are tests F9, F10 and F12.
Start New Session takes me back without reloading the page. The new session is shuffled again, and everything starts from zero.
I can also end a session early. The result then counts only the questions I answered. That is test F23.
Success criterion nine is the history. Every session is saved on this computer. I can see my statistics, a progress chart, the questions I miss most, and my mistakes from each session.
Practise my mistakes starts a session with only the questions I got wrong before.
Success criterion ten: I can use my own questions and pictures. I choose two images and a CSV file that needs three. The app tells me which picture is missing.
In the quiz, my own picture is shown with its question.
The app also works in Lithuanian. The questions stay the same, so my history still matches.
Finally, some examples of the testing.
These are the structural tests. They check each main function with valid, extreme and invalid data, and all thirty-one pass. Test S4 found a real bug with quotation marks, which was then fixed.
In test F24 the internet is blocked. The app still works and shows only the start screen. Before the fix, all four screens appeared at once.
The functional tests use only the interface, like a real user. All twenty-four pass. Thank you for watching.
